summary: Expanded the universe around the restaurant franchisee capex and real-estate chokepoint. The cleanest public-market mappings are net-lease REITs and sale-leaseback platforms that own or finance restaurant boxes, plus SBA/franchise lenders and site-development service firms that can enable or constrain new-unit growth. FCPT and EPRT are the strongest direct real-estate reference names; LOB is a plausible franchise-credit capacity play; BWMN is a speculative development-services candidate tied to permitting, due diligence, engineering, and speed-to-market constraints for retail sites. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
